name: Mouth Taping
title: Test mouth taping to force nasal breathing overnight.
benefit: Possibly quieter and more restful sleep.
subtitle: Sleep Experiment
rationale: The evidence is thin, but the practice is cheap enough to test directly for anyone who breathes comfortably through the nose.

evidence.summary: Popular practice with plausible rationale for mouth breathers; direct trial evidence is minimal and safety screening matters more than the tape.

sources.label: Sleep Foundation review of mouth taping

indications: Mornings start with dry mouth or a sore throat.
Nasal breathing is comfortable while awake.
